practiceReport.name: Bhayshul Tuten
practiceReport.archetypeNote: Perimeter speed/cut position (RB) — requires full deceleration/burst clearance on lower-body tags (76% Questionable baseline).
factors: Questionable tag adjusted by player career prior (76%)
practiceReport.beatComment: Tuten carried 10 times for 33 yards and recorded three receptions for 20 yards before exiting the contest with 3:40 remaining, when his ankle got stepped on for the second time that day. Though the injury was to the same ankle/foot that has resulted in Tuten being listed on the Jacksonville injury report for three straight weeks, Coen seemed to imply that the aggravation isn't viewed as a major concern. Even so, Tuten's practice activity is likely to be affected in Week 12, putting his availability for next Sunday's game against the Titans in question.
